milestones.name: Defeat Elder Hu
milestones.note: Fight Elder Hu's spirit at his memorial above the gates to the City of Tears; requires Dream Nail to access

milestones.name: Acquire Dream Nail
milestones.note: Required to initiate the Elder Hu spirit fight and to collect Essence

milestones.name: Collect 100 Essence from Elder Hu
milestones.note: Elder Hu shatters into 100 Essence upon defeat, collected by the Dream Nail

milestones.name: Obtain Love Key
milestones.note: Held by a large dead Husk Dandy; can also be Dream Nailed for lore dialogue

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Rainy city area, husks as enemies, characters like Cornifer, Nailsmith, Relic Seeker Lemm, Hornet, Quirrel, Zote the Mighty, Eternal Emilitia
zones.note: Main zone of this segment; contains Elder Hu memorial above its gates

zones.name: Mantis Village
zones.note: Referenced in lore as the location where Elder Hu was killed by the Mantis Lords and Tribe

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.note: Referenced as a location; Love Key corpse has a noted location there

abilities.name: Dream Nail
abilities.grants: Access to spirit fights, Essence collection, and Dream Nail dialogue on enemies/objects
abilities.note: Required to fight Elder Hu's spirit and collect his 100 Essence; also used on the Husk Dandy corpse for dialogue

abilities.name: Shade Cloak
abilities.note: Highly recommended for dodging Elder Hu's Ring Slam and Ring Curtain attacks; enables dash-through strategy

abilities.name: Howling Wraiths
abilities.note: Spell usable in Elder Hu fight, especially effective with Spell build (Shaman Stone, Spell Twister, Soul Catcher, Soul Eater)

abilities.name: Abyss Shriek
abilities.note: Upgraded spell usable in Elder Hu fight as alternative to Howling Wraiths

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Spirit of a travelling sage fought at his memorial above City of Tears gates; requires Dream Nail to initiate. Attacks: Ring Slam, Ring Curtain, Teleport. Drops 100 Essence on defeat.

objectives.name: Acquire Dream Nail before challenging Elder Hu
objectives.hopDescription: Obtain the Dream Nail ability to unlock the Elder Hu spirit fight at the City of Tears memorial

objectives.name: Dodge Ring Slam and Ring Curtain attacks
objectives.hopDescription: Use precise movement or Shade Cloak to avoid Elder Hu's ring attacks; attack him during openings or with Spells

objectives.name: Collect 100 Essence from Elder Hu
objectives.hopDescription: Use Dream Nail to absorb the 100 Essence shed when Elder Hu's spirit is defeated

objectives.name: Obtain Love Key from Husk Dandy corpse
objectives.hopDescription: Locate the large dead Husk Dandy holding the Love Key; optionally Dream Nail it for lore dialogue
objectives.note: Love Key location is noted in Queen's Gardens

objectives.name: Explore City of Tears Points of Interest
objectives.hopDescription: Collect Vessel Fragment, Simple Key, Grubs x2, Whispering Root (28 Essence near City Storerooms), Wanderer's Journals x2, Hallownest Seal, Geo Deposits x6, Soul Totem in City of Tears

connectors.description: Soul Sanctum is a sub-area accessible from within the City of Tears
Elder Hu travelled from Mantis Village borderlands toward City of Tears; his memorial is above the City of Tears gates
connectors.note: Lore/narrative connection only — Elder Hu's journey

connectors.description: Love Key corpse (Husk Dandy) is noted as located in Queen's Gardens, referenced from the City of Tears segment
connectors.note: Love Key item connection between zones
